questions.question: ___________ becomes second Indian state to achieve 100% literacy.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Goa becomes second Indian state to achieve 100% literacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Goa has achieved 100% literacy** under the **ULLAS Nav Bharat Literacy Programme**.

 
 
• 
 
**ULLAS** stands for **Understanding for Lifelong Learning for All in Society**.

 
 
• 
 
Also known as **New India Literacy Programme (NILP)**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **centrally sponsored scheme**, aligned with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**.

 
 
• 
 
Targets individuals **aged 15 and above** who missed formal schooling.

 
 
• 
 
Focuses on **functional literacy** – reading, writing, and numeracy.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to achieve **100% national literacy by 2030**.

 
 
• 
 
The milestone was announced during **Goa’s 39th Statehood Day**.

questions.question: Har Shikhar Tiranga culminates with the successful ________________ expedition.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kanchenjunga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

**Har Shikhar Tiranga”** mission actually **culminated with the successful expedition to Mt. Kangchenjunga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Har Shikhar Tiranga mission** successfully culminated after climbing **Kanchenjunga** (height: **8586 m**).
 
• The mission was led by **Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal**, Director of **NIMAS** and team leader of the expedition.
 
• A **five-member team** hoisted the **Indian national flag (Tiranga)** on the **highest peak of every state** in India.
 
• Team members included **Col R S Jamwal**, **Naib Subedar Tsewang Chosgail**, **NB Sub Nehpal Singh**, **Havaldar Kewal**, and **Havaldar Sushil Kumar**.
 
• The expedition overcame **blizzards** and other challenges on **Kanchenjunga**, one of India’s toughest peaks.
 
• The mission aligned with **PM Narendra Modi’s vision of Meri Maati Mera Desh**, collecting soil from mountains of all **28 Indian states**.
 
• It was the **first-ever expedition** in India covering **30,000 km** in one year to climb the **highest points of all 28 states**.

questions.question: How many total medals did India win at the World Boxing Cup Brazil 2025?

• 
 
**India** won **6 medals** at **World Boxing Cup Brazil 2025**.

questions.question: To whom did President Droupadi Murmu confer the 58th Jnanpith Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu conferred the 58th Jnanpith Award to Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar for their exceptional contributions to literature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and Gulzar were honored with the 58th Jnanpith Award for their significant contributions to Indian literature.**
 
• Gulzar was unable to attend the ceremony due to health reasons, but both laureates were praised by the President for their impact on literary heritage.
 
• The President emphasized the role of literature in uniting society and its importance in shaping national identity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Jnanpith Award__

 __
 
• India's highest literary honor, given annually for exceptional contributions to literature.
 
• Recognizes writers for their outstanding works in any Indian language.
 
 
 
• Jagadguru Rambhadracharya__
 __
 
• Famous for his work in philosophy, literature, and his role as a spiritual leader.
 
 
 
• Gulzar__
 
 
• A renowned poet, lyricist, and filmmaker, known for his contributions to Hindi literature and cinema.

questions.question: Who is the 52nd Chief Justice of India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Justice B R Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai, the 52nd Chief Justice of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** is the **52nd Chief Justice of India (CJI)**.

 
 
• 
 
Sworn in by **President Droupadi Murmu**.

 
 
• 
 
**Tenure:** Six months, ending **November 23, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**First Buddhist** and **second Dalit** (after K.G. Balakrishnan) to head the Indian judiciary.

 
 
• 
 
**Landmark Judgments (as SC judge):**

 
 
• 
 
**Article 370 abrogation** (upheld).

 
 
• 
 
**Electoral bonds scheme** (struck down).

 
 
• 
 
**2016 Demonetisation** (upheld).

 
 
• 
 
**Freedom of speech of public functionaries** (no extra restrictions).

 
 
• 
 
**Sub-classification within Scheduled Castes** for reservation (allowed).

 
 
• 
 
**Arbitration clause in unstamped agreements** (held valid, curable defect).

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)? (May 2025)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Dr. Ajay Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Former Defence Secretary Ajay Kumar appointed as UPSC Chairman

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**President Droupadi Murmu** has appointed **Dr. Ajay Kumar** as the new **Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)**.

 
 
• 
 
The appointment was announced by the **Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)**.

 
 
• 
 
**Dr. Kumar’s tenure** will begin **from the day he assumes charge**.

 
 
• 
 
He is a **retired IAS officer** from the **1985 batch**, **Kerala cadre**.

 
 
• 
 
Dr. Ajay Kumar served as **Defence Secretary** from **August 2019 to October 2022**.
